name: ROW_ID_AND_ASSERTION_SLOT
later_citc_requirement: Every CITC row binds proposition/comparison claim, assertion slot, invariant and registered loss dimension
notes: Inherited FFIF006 row grain

name: CRITICALITY_STATE
later_citc_requirement: Freeze HARD_ZERO / BOUNDED_APPROXIMATION / INFORMATION_NOT_REQUIRED / UNRESOLVED / NOT_APPLICABLE
notes: No producer may choose after outputs

name: TOLERANCE_TYPE_VALUE_RULE
later_citc_requirement: Exact zero, bounded numeric rule, logical rule, no requirement, or unresolved
notes: No universal threshold

name: UNIT_SCALE_DIRECTION_OF_WORSE_LOSS
later_citc_requirement: Freeze units, value domain and monotonic loss interpretation
notes: Prevents score/scale laundering

name: AGGREGATION_RULE
later_citc_requirement: Freeze noncompensatory vector/logical aggregation or NONE
notes: No scalar master score

name: SUPPORT_UNCERTAINTY_INTERACTION
later_citc_requirement: Bind future support contract ref/hash and state how uncertainty affects tolerance
notes: Support cannot silently authorize materiality

name: SOURCE_RESOLUTION_ERROR_MODEL
later_citc_requirement: Freeze source resolution and any design/error-model refs or explicit NONE
notes: Exact sample descriptive rows may lawfully use NONE

name: AUTHORITY_AND_EVIDENCE
later_citc_requirement: Authority basis/ref, evidence refs, independence, outcome-blind freeze receipt
notes: Observed result is never authority

name: ALLOWED_FORBIDDEN_USES
later_citc_requirement: Freeze promotion ceiling, especially no inference/causality/engineering rescue
notes: Inherited first-canary firewall

name: VALIDITY_SUPERSESSION_HASH
later_citc_requirement: Freeze validity, supersession, canonical hash
notes: Any tolerance change creates different comparison contract

name: EMPIRICAL_UNIT_RISK_SET_COEXPOSURE_IDENTITY
later_citc_requirement: Zero unauthorized unit substitution, risk-set drift or exposure counterfeit
notes: Constitutive before any support calculation

name: COMMON_SEMANTIC_INPUT_TTAR_PRA_IDENTITY
later_citc_requirement: Zero semantic-input, TTAR sequence or constitutive role mismatch
notes: No postfork role/state change

name: CONTRAST_C_c1_c0_DIRECTION_IDENTITY
later_citc_requirement: Exact contrast operand, states, baseline/comparison and c1-minus-c0 direction
notes: Reversing baseline is not harmless display change

name: DESTINATION_AND_F_IDENTITY
later_citc_requirement: Exact D state universe and exact direction functional/event/score/vector relation identity
notes: No post-output d* or event selection

name: Z_TUPLE_AND_EXACT_JOINT_PREDICATE_IDENTITY
later_citc_requirement: Exact Z tuple, joint predicate semantics and complete frozen domain generator
notes: Ephemeral query still instantiates exact joint-state relation

name: SUPPORT_ADMISSION_AND_ABSTENTION_IDENTITY
later_citc_requirement: Exact support contract, denominator-existence rule or authorized stronger rule, and no silent state deletion
notes: Observed support values are evidence, not tolerance authority

name: BROAD_EXACT_REALIZED_SAMPLE_CONTRAST_PRESERVATION
later_citc_requirement: If proposition is exact sample descriptive, exact recovery of broad probability/event/vector contrast
authority_dependency: Claim-materiality authority from exact proposition semantics
notes: No approximation margin unless separately authorized

name: WITHIN_STATE_EXACT_REALIZED_SAMPLE_CONTRAST_PRESERVATION
later_citc_requirement: For every support-admitted s, exact recovery of same contrast under added exact predicate
authority_dependency: Claim-materiality authority from exact proposition semantics
notes: Unsupported s abstains rather than backoffs

name: EXACT_SIGN_PRESERVATION
later_citc_requirement: Positive/zero/negative sign of every identified broad/within scalar contrast preserved exactly
notes: Sign is not a materiality threshold

name: COMPOUND_LOGIC_AND_ABSTENTION_PRESERVATION
later_citc_requirement: Exact preregistered EXISTS/ALL/set logic and propagation of zero/unsupported/unresolved statuses
notes: Prevents state-set/result laundering

name: MATERIAL_DIFFERENCE
later_citc_requirement: If future claim uses MATERIAL_DIFFERENCE, freeze numeric/logical materiality rule and units
authority_dependency: Competent pre-output materiality authority with evidence basis
notes: No universal percentage, TV, or effect threshold

name: DISAPPEARANCE_OR_NULL_EQUIVALENCE
later_citc_requirement: If future claim uses disappearance/null-equivalence, freeze exact equivalence region or authorized statistical/null rule
notes: Exact observed zero may be reported as EXACT_ZERO_DIFFERENCE but is not automatically inferential null-equivalence

name: PERSISTENCE_WITHIN_TOLERANCE
later_citc_requirement: If persistence means more than exact same nonzero direction, freeze allowed broad-within magnitude/tolerance relation
notes: DIRECTIONAL_PERSISTENCE can be exact sign logic without this row; magnitude/equivalence persistence cannot

name: VECTOR_COMPONENT_PRESERVATION_AND_SCALARIZATION_CEILING
later_citc_requirement: Preserve every constitutive native-state component; forbid scalar aggregation unless separately authorized
notes: A norm or score is a new functional, not convenience

name: STORAGE_PERSISTENCE_COMPRESSION_RUNTIME
later_citc_requirement: Storage/index/persistence/runtime differences are not claim truth unless future proposition explicitly says otherwise
notes: Cannot split AOS or rescue claim sufficiency

name: GEOMETRY_TOPOLOGY_MOTIF_MODEL_TRANSPORT
later_citc_requirement: Not required absent explicit future assertion slot
notes: No prestige competitor admission
